name: Vasterbotten County (Sweden)

colors.symbolism: the reindeer, the salmon, and the field of the Lappland section
the stars strewn on the Västerbotten field

description: A banner of the county arms: the upper half blue strewn with golden stars bearing a white reindeer (Västerbotten); the lower hoist white with a red wild man bearing a club (Lappland); the lower fly blue with three white salmon (Ångermanland).
history: Västerbotten County's arms, granted on 18 January 1949, combine the arms of Västerbotten, Lappland and Ångermanland — parted per fess, the base per pale; the flag is the heraldic banner of those arms.

features.role: arms of Västerbotten County: Västerbotten above Lappland and Ångermanland
